basic_details.job_title: AIIMS Delhi Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 3 Project Research Scientist, Project Technical Support Posts
basic_details.short_information: The Department of Pathology, All India Institute of Medical Sciences (AIIMS), New Delhi, is inviting applications for 3 temporary posts under an ICMR-funded project (Project Code: I-2036). The project runs for 3 years, from 23 September 2026 to 22 September 2029. The posts are 1 Project Research Scientist–I (Non-Medical) at ₹56,000/- + HRA and 2 Project Technical Support–I at ₹18,000/- + HRA. The Research Scientist post needs a Post Graduate Degree. Project Research Scientist–I (Non-Medical); Project Technical Support–I
₹56,000/- + HRA (Project Research Scientist–I); ₹18,000/- + HRA (Project Technical Support–I)

content_sections.heading: About AIIMS New Delhi
content_sections.text: AIIMS, New Delhi (All India Institute of Medical Sciences) is a medical institute in New Delhi. These posts are in its Department of Pathology. They serve an ICMR-funded research project on a patent-based preservation system for cerebrospinal fluid cytology and immunophenotyping in malignancies. The Principal Investigator (AIIMS) is Dr. Lavleen Singh, Assistant Professor, Department of Pathology.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notice advertises 3 posts in total under the project. FREEJOBALERT DAILY QUIZ Preparing for Govt Exams? Test Yourself! 25 Questions · 20 Minutes · Instant Score Take Today's Free Quiz →

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Age relaxation will be applicable as per ICMR/Government of India rules, wherever admissible. Hands-on experience in cytology, cell biology, flow cytometry, immunocytochemistry, or related laboratory techniques. Experience in biological sample processing, cell counting, microscopy, and laboratory documentation. Working knowledge of data analysis/statistical software and research documentation. Candidates with CSIR-UGC NET, ICMR-NET, DBT-BET, GATE or equivalent national-level qualification will be given preference. Knowledge of CSF/sample collection, processing, storage, labeling, and record maintenance. Experience with centrifuge/cytospin, micropipettes, cell counting, microscopy, and routine laboratory equipment. Knowledge of laboratory safety, SOPs, biomedical waste management, and quality-control practices. Basic computer skills and experience in laboratory data entry/documentation. Check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

rows.essential_qualification: Post Graduate Degree, including integrated PG degrees, in Life Sciences / Biomedical Sciences or allied discipline.
10th + Diploma (MLT/DMLT/ITI or equivalent) + two years' experience in relevant subject/field. OR Three-year Graduate degree in relevant subject/field + one year experience in relevant subject/field.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Both posts get HRA on top of the salary, "as admissible". The Project Research Scientist–I (Non-Medical) gets ₹56,000/- + HRA and the Project Technical Support–I gets ₹18,000/- + HRA. The posts are purely temporary and co-terminus with the project, so they last only as long as the ICMR project does.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for AIIMS New Delhi Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: You apply by submitting the Google Form at https://forms.gle/tcsBiSTUZCvpLeCG8. The notice also prints a QR code for the same form. The last date for receipt of applications is 10 November 2026, till 5:00 PM. For questions, the notice gives this enquiry email: [email protected] .

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Only shortlisted candidates will be called for an interview at AIIMS, New Delhi. No TA/DA will be provided for attending the interview.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in AIIMS New Delhi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 3 vacancies: 01 Project Research Scientist–I (Non-Medical) and 02 Project Technical Support–I, under the ICMR-funded project in the Department of Pathology.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the AIIMS New Delhi project posts?
faq.answer: Applications must be received by 10 November 2026, till 5:00 PM.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for Project Research Scientist–I (Non-Medical)?
faq.answer: You need a Post Graduate Degree, including integrated PG degrees, in Life Sciences / Biomedical Sciences or allied discipline. Candidates with CSIR-UGC NET, ICMR-NET, DBT-BET, GATE or an equivalent national-level qualification will be given preference.

faq.question: Q4. What qualification is needed for Project Technical Support–I?
faq.answer: You need 10th + Diploma (MLT/DMLT/ITI or equivalent) + two years' experience in relevant subject/field, OR a three-year Graduate degree in relevant subject/field + one year experience in relevant subject/field.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for AIIMS New Delhi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 35 years for Project Research Scientist–I (Non-Medical) and 28 years for Project Technical Support–I. Age relaxation applies as per ICMR/Government of India rules, wherever admissible.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for the AIIMS New Delhi project posts?
faq.answer: Project Research Scientist–I (Non-Medical) gets ₹56,000/- + HRA, as admissible. Project Technical Support–I gets ₹18,000/- + HRA, as admissible.

faq.question: Q7. Is HRA paid on top of the salary?
faq.answer: Yes. For both posts, HRA, as admissible, is paid in addition to the salary.

faq.answer: Submit the Google Form at https://forms.gle/tcsBiSTUZCvpLeCG8 by 5:00 PM on 10 November 2026. Send any questions to [email protected].
